title: Live on AscendEX! Copi Cafe Episode 61 | Cornucopias
description:
In this episode Josh Jones and Rob Greig dive deep into ongoing testing and the gamification enhancements that have been added. But that's not all – they've got a juicy exclusive leak about in-game communications waiting for you!

They'll also be addressing some burning community questions and discussing the highly anticipated AscendEX Listing. Plus, get ready for their insights on the latest Star Atlas news.

And of course, they finish strong with another exciting leak! So grab your favorite beverage, get cozy, and don't miss this action-packed episode! Hit that play button now! 

00:00 Beverage Choices
05:57 Testing
21:46 Proximity Voice Chat
23:09 Community Questions 
32:59 AscendEX
35:19 Star Atlas
39:50 Leak!

Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. 

The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. 

Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.

The Cornucopias Metaverse is a network of floating bubbles and domes, each with diverse themes and characteristics. Here, players of all ages can engage in a series of mini-games and explore vast landscapes in search of precious resources which can be crafted into valuable items.
